notes: Fixed a real duplicate-vehicle bug in the fleet database: 117 stored FLEET records actually represented only 92 real physical vehicles (24 vehicles were each recorded twice, once under an old plate number and once under a new one after re-registration). Merged every duplicate pair by chassis number (the one identifier that never changes), kept the more complete record as current, preserved the old plate number(s) as a documented note on the vehicle, archived the removed duplicate records (nothing deleted), and rewrote every cross-referenced record (fuel logs, maintenance, violations, tracking, fault reports, document audit log) from the old plate to the current one so operational history stays intact. 23 of the 24 merges had a genuine data conflict (different driver, worksite, or owner name recorded against the two plates) — these are now logged as review-needed findings inside the app rather than silently resolved. Added a permanent guard test that fails the build if any future vehicle is ever recorded under two plates again.
